usage.callShape: POST https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/chat/completions with OpenAI-compatible JSON body {model, messages[], max_tokens} — model MUST be "moonshot/kimi-k2.6" (lowercase, slash form)
quirks: This is the blockrun.ai backend (backendIndex 2), a DIFFERENT host than the other Kimi K2 backend (x402.telnyx.com). The model param string differs by host: blockrun wants 'moonshot/kimi-k2.6' (lowercase, slash); telnyx wants 'moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6'. Do not mix them.
The registry/service id 'kimi-k2' is NOT a valid model param value — use 'moonshot/kimi-k2.6'.
Observed cost was $0.001 USDC on Base for a tiny call (cheaper than the telnyx backend's ~$0.02); price likely scales with tokens.
qa-pay reported confirmed:false / txHash:null but status 200 with a valid completion body — payment settled and the call succeeded.
usage.guide: POST to https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/chat/completions with an OpenAI-style JSON body. Set model to "moonshot/kimi-k2.6" (lowercase with a slash — this backend's exact string, distinct from the telnyx backend's "moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6"). Pass messages as an array of {role, content} objects and optionally max_tokens. Payment is via x402 (USDC on Base, ~$0.001 for a small call, scales with tokens). Read the assistant reply from body.choices[0].message.content and token usage from body.usage.
